---
title: "CNScolor"
---

```{r}
#| echo: false

library(pixture)

scircolor <- read.csv("files/sciRcolor.csv")
paths <- paste("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZhengTiger/PlotOnePiece/refs/heads/main/images/sciRcolor/", scircolor$image, sep="")
link <- scircolor$link
```

```{r}
#| echo: false

pixgallery(
  path = paths,
  link = link,
  gap = "20px",
  h = "276.65px",
  w = "200px", 
  layout = "fixed"
)
```
